headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.26
summary: This release adopts upstream's redesigned mod management and instance screens and re-wires every fork feature onto them: the loader card, clear-cache card, stats row, in-game mod menu switch and the import dialogs all live in the new compact design. The left and right nav rails become icon-only columns with tooltips, the personalization cards match the rest of the settings, and the global mod menu toggle keeps working beside the new per-instance one.

items.text: Mod management and instance settings rebuilt on the upstream redesign: popup-based menus, compact rows and a slimmer settings page, with the fork's loader card, clear-cache card, stats row, in-game mod menu switch and the device/GitHub/MediaFire import dialogs re-wired onto the new structure. Note: the old "only show enabled mods" checkbox and the drag auto-scroll did not survive the new layout.

The mod list rows follow the new flat-row design (inset dividers, ripple rows, tag chips) while keeping every fork display: mod icon, source badge, size and date line, and the compatibility warning, all restyled to match the new tag and caption language.

Left and right navigation rails are now compact icon-only columns with hover tooltips, and the fork-added personalization cards (background animation, navigation bar position) get the same margins and glass tint as the rest of the settings.
The global in-game mod menu toggle from the mods screen works again beside the new per-instance setting: the overlay now honors both, and client mods still load based on it at game start.
